Public Health Response to an Avian Influenza A(H7N8) Virus Outbreak in Commercial Turkey Flocks — Indiana, 2016
Among these 166 responders, 74 (45%) were monitored for some risk exposures, 67 (40%) were monitored for low but not zero risk exposures

methods_quotes.q: influenza-like illness (ILI), defined as either 1) self-reported fever with cough or sore throat, or 2) conjunctivitis with or without additional symptoms.
Responders were classified into three risk categories: 1) no risk, 2) low but not zero risk, and 3) some risk.
Specimens were tested for influenza A virus by real-time reverse transcription–polymerase chain reaction at the ISDH Laboratories
